# github.com/go-again/sqlite

> CGo-free SQLite driver for Go, drop-in replacement for mattn/go-sqlite3,
> modernc.org/sqlite, glebarez/sqlite, and gorm.io/driver/sqlite. Ships
> typed vector search (sqlite-vec) and full-text search (FTS5) sub-packages,
> a gorm dialector, and a read-only fs.FS-as-VFS adapter.

The driver registers under two names so it slots into either ecosystem's
blank imports verbatim: `"sqlite"` (modernc-compatible) and `"sqlite3"`
(mattn-compatible). Same singleton, no behavioural split. Supports the
two most recent Go releases only (today: 1.26 current, 1.25 previous);
modern syntax is treated as a feature — generics, iter.Seq2, log/slog,
range-over-int, sync.WaitGroup.Go, etc. are all in use.

## Read this first

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): full consumer guide — driver picker, DSN flags, sub-package map, pitfalls, migration recipes, what NOT to do. Read this when integrating the package into a project for the first time.
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing landing page with motivation and Quick start.

## Per-package overviews (pkg.go.dev renders these)

- [doc.go](doc.go): root `package sqlite` — driver registration, hooks, mattn-compat surface.
- [vec/doc.go](vec/doc.go): typed sqlite-vec vector search (`Table`, `KNN`, `Neighbor`, `Row`, `WithFilter`).
- [fts/doc.go](fts/doc.go): typed FTS5 full-text search (`Index[K,V]`, `Hit[K,V]`, query builder, ranking, snippet, highlight).
- Root `sqlite` package: modern Go-typed Config in `config.go` + `open_config.go` — `sqlite.Open(sqlite.Config{Path, Pragmas, Encryption, ...}) (*sqlite.DB, error)`. Backward-compatible with `sql.Open("sqlite", dsn)`.
- [gorm/doc.go](gorm/doc.go): gorm dialector — drop-in for glebarez/sqlite and gorm.io/driver/sqlite. Also exposes `sqlitegorm.OpenConfig(sqlite.Config, ...gorm.Config) (*sqlitegorm.DB, error)` for the modern Go-typed entry.
- [vec/gorm/doc.go](vec/gorm/doc.go): tag-driven sqlite-vec sidecars (`vec:"dim=N;metric=…"`) on gorm models.
- [fts/gorm/doc.go](fts/gorm/doc.go): tag-driven FTS5 sidecars (`fts5:"tokenize=…;external=…;contentless=…"`) on gorm models.
- [vfs/doc.go](vfs/doc.go): expose any `fs.FS` (embed.FS, fstest.MapFS, zip-fs) as a read-only SQLite VFS.
- [vfs/crypto/doc.go](vfs/crypto/doc.go): pure-Go encryption-at-rest VFS — Adiantum / AES-XTS-256, transparent page-level encryption of main DB + journal + WAL + temp files.
- [fusion/doc.go](fusion/doc.go): rank-fusion helpers — combine vec.KNN and fts.Search results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (Cormack 2009).
- [ext/README.md](ext/README.md): loadable Go extensions umbrella — opt-in SQL scalar UDFs, table-valued functions, and vtab-based readers. Each sub-package independent; pick by need. Several are Go-native ports of ncruces/go-sqlite3 extensions. See [docs/coverage-ext.md](docs/coverage-ext.md) for the full matrix.

## Examples (runnable)

- [examples/mattn-compat](examples/mattn-compat/main.go): one-line import swap from mattn/go-sqlite3.
- [examples/modernc-compat](examples/modernc-compat/main.go): one-line import swap from modernc.org/sqlite.
- [examples/gorm](examples/gorm/main.go): basic gorm CRUD.
- [examples/gorm-vfs](examples/gorm-vfs/main.go): gorm reading from a fstest.MapFS via vfs/.
- [examples/gorm-vec](examples/gorm-vec/main.go): gorm + vec sidecar (side-by-side, no plugin).
- [examples/gorm-fts](examples/gorm-fts/main.go): gorm + fts external-content (side-by-side, no plugin).
- [examples/gorm-vec-tagged](examples/gorm-vec-tagged/main.go): tag-driven vec sidecars via vec/gorm plugin.
- [examples/gorm-fts-tagged](examples/gorm-fts-tagged/main.go): tag-driven FTS5 sidecars via fts/gorm plugin.
- [examples/vec-search](examples/vec-search/main.go): raw `vec.Table` API.
- [examples/fts-search](examples/fts-search/main.go): raw `fts.Index` API.
- [examples/fusion-hybrid-search](examples/fusion-hybrid-search/main.go): combine vec.KNN + fts.Search rankings via fusion.RRF2.
- [examples/window-function](examples/window-function/main.go): Conn.RegisterWindowFunction demo.
- [examples/vfs-embed](examples/vfs-embed/main.go): bundle a `.db` inside `embed.FS`.
- [examples/sqlite-config](examples/sqlite-config/main.go): modern Go-typed `sqlite.Config` for plain *sql.DB — plain + encrypted variants, no DSN strings.
- [examples/gorm-config](examples/gorm-config/main.go): same `sqlite.Config` routed through gorm via `sqlitegorm.OpenConfig`.
- [examples/vfs-crypto](examples/vfs-crypto/main.go): encryption at rest via vfs/crypto (Adiantum / AES-XTS-256, pure Go).
- [examples/gorm-crypto](examples/gorm-crypto/main.go): gorm + vfs/crypto + vec/gorm + fts/gorm + fusion — encrypted DB with embedding sidecars, FTS5 search, hybrid ranking via RRF, argon2id key derivation, slog Recorder, WAL + busy_timeout.
- [examples/ext-array](examples/ext-array/main.go): bind a Go slice as a SQL table via the `ext/array` eponymous vtab; shows explicit `array.Register` + `array.Bind` and the blank-import auto path; JOINs the array against a normal table to demonstrate composition.
- [examples/ext-regexp](examples/ext-regexp/main.go): REGEXP operator + regexp_substr / regexp_replace over a small users table.
- [examples/ext-uuid](examples/ext-uuid/main.go): generate v1/v4/v6/v7 + name-based v5; parse + reformat round-trip via uuid_str/uuid_blob.
- [examples/ext-hash](examples/ext-hash/main.go): md5/sha1/sha2/sha3/blake2b digests + sha3 size variants.
- [examples/ext-ipaddr](examples/ext-ipaddr/main.go): ipcontains/ipfamily/ipnetwork over an events table with mixed IPv4 / IPv6 sources.
- [examples/ext-zorder](examples/ext-zorder/main.go): 2D Morton encoding round-trip + locality property demo.
- [examples/ext-stats](examples/ext-stats/main.go): PostgreSQL-style aggregates (variance, percentile, regr_*, median, mode, every) plus a windowed regr_slope demo over a small employees table.
- [examples/ext-unicode](examples/ext-unicode/main.go): Unicode-aware case mapping (with locale-tagged forms for Turkish / German), normalize, unaccent, NOCASE_UNICODE / NOCASE_ACCENT preset collations, plus a Swedish-locale collation that sorts `å` after `z`.

## Feature coverage matrices

- [docs/coverage-sql.md](docs/coverage-sql.md): SQLite raw-SQL surface (SELECT clauses, joins, CTEs, windows, JSON1, datetime, constraints, triggers, UPSERT, RETURNING, PRAGMA).
- [docs/coverage-vec.md](docs/coverage-vec.md): every documented sqlite-vec feature with status (typed / raw / inherited).
- [docs/coverage-fts.md](docs/coverage-fts.md): every FTS5 feature with status.
- [docs/coverage-gorm.md](docs/coverage-gorm.md): every gorm.Dialector / Migrator / ErrorTranslator method with status.
- [docs/coverage-ext.md](docs/coverage-ext.md): every `ext/` loadable extension with status (✓ landed / ⚠ partial / ✗ deferred / ✗ skipped), upstream reference, and the test pin. Includes the per-extension scaffolding checklist.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): for agents working **inside** this repo (maintainers). Points at CLAUDE.md for the full repo-onboarding guide.
